messages:
sophie (support): customer on Dedicated EU1 says per-model throughput lines disappeared around 14:02 UTC. total qps still shows, just the per-model series are gone. https://console.redwood/models/throughput
noah (oncall): copy — do we have any recent deploys in eu1?
metrics-bot: deploy/exporter v2 -> eu1 succeeded 2026-03-10T13:48:17Z
noah (oncall): that might be it. any recent config changes?
tom (eng-platform): I did push exporter v2 earlier that normalizes model labels. It changes the label shape (we intended model -> model_name compatibility, might have flipped names).
maya (eng-runtime): If label key changed panels that group by the old label will go quiet. Can you paste the Grafana PromQL from the customer's dashboard?
sophie (support): paste from customer: `sum by (model_id) (rate(redwood_inference_requests_total[1m]))`
tom (eng-platform): there you go — exporter v2 emits `model` and `model_namespace` now, we removed `model_id` in the rename. Some environments ended up with `model` while others have `model_name` due to a relabel rule edge-case.
noah (oncall): deploy timeline lines up. customer says panels went silent right after 13:50-14:00 UTC.
maya (eng-runtime): quick repro on staging: `sum by (model) (rate(redwood_inference_requests_total[1m]))` returns expected lines. So dashboards must be updated OR we re-add compatibility labels.
tom (eng-platform): Immediate mitigation options: 1) hotpatch exporter to emit `model_id` in addition to `model` 2) add a Prometheus relabel_config to copy `model`->`model_id` 3) update all dashboards to use `model`. Fastest is (1) or (2).
sophie (support): customer needs ETA, marking this P1 for them. Can we do a hotpatch for eu1 today?
maya (eng-runtime): I can push a canary build that emits `model_id` for backward compatibility. Estimate 20-30m to build + canary rollout. Will keep `model` as well to avoid two-way breakage.
noah (oncall): I'll coordinate a 15% canary, monitor the per-model panels and SLOs.
tom (eng-platform): also creating task to update dashboard queries to `model` and add migration note in docs. We should also add dashboard CI tests to catch label renames in future.
metrics-bot: grafana_alert: per-model-panels-down fired at 2026-03-10T14:05:08Z
sophie (support): relaying ETA to customer: ~30-40 minutes for canary + verification. Sharing rollback plan as well.
maya (eng-runtime): patch merged to canary, starting rollout to 15% now. I'll post logs if anything pops.
sophie (support): customer acknowledged, thx team :thumbsup:
tom (eng-platform): follow-up TODOs: update dashboards, add compatibility relabeling in exporter config, add dashboard unit test.
sophie (support): closing loop when eu1 canary shows per-model lines restored or we roll back.
